def test_qda_priors():

    y_pred = clf.fit(X6, y6).predict(X6)
    n_pos = np.sum(y_pred == 2)

    neg = 1e-10
    clf = QuadraticDiscriminantAnalysis(priors=np.array([neg, 1 - neg]))
    y_pred = clf.fit(X6, y6).predict(X6)
    n_pos2 = np.sum(y_pred == 2)
